timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: We have on-prem Active Directory. Can't we just... keep it?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: You keep it, Peter. But you sync it to Entra ID so cloud apps have one identity.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: And there are two sync tools? That seems excessive.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Cloud Sync is the modern one: lightweight agent, multi-forest support, easy high availability.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So when do I ever need Connect Sync?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Pass-through auth, device sync for hybrid join, Domain Services, or over 150,000 objects.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Pass-through auth sounds safer. Passwords stay on-premises, right?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: True, but it needs agents online. Password hash sync gives you leaked-credential detection and cloud resiliency.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Smart cards, on-premises policy. Also a whole extra server farm to keep alive.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So what do most orgs pick?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Password hash sync. Strongest cloud features, best resiliency. And check your Connect Sync version — old builds stop September 30, 2026.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Any trick to make logins painless?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Seamless SSO. Kerberos tickets sign users in silently on the corporate network.
